anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: The melon exhibits a broad, semi-circular convexity with a large radius relative to the cranial length, creating a prominent and rounded forehead profile.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: The rostrum is short and robust, with a visible length from the melon crease to the tip that is approximately equal to its vertical thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: A distinct concave crease is visible where the melon transitions into the rostrum, forming an obtuse interior angle of approximately 135 to 140 degrees.
